_description: Report-STRUCTURE audit corpus (ADR-0010 deck granularity). The standard `eval-summary` gates FAITHFULNESS (mention-recall + must_not_assert + summarize/refuse). This corpus measures the STRUCTURE/COHERENCE quality a granularity change targets — so a change can be compared against a baseline and checked for no-regression. Decks (heavily-packed → the granularity-limited case). Source docs stay LOCAL (tests/eval-data/README.md); only this config + the baseline ship.

_metrics.section_summaries: upstream granularity the packing controls (fewer = coarser)
_metrics.distinctness: 1 - mean pairwise content-Jaccard between paragraphs; the ANTI-REPETITION metric (low = paragraphs repeat each other)
_metrics.violations: must_not_assert leaks (the no-hallucination HARD gate — must stay 0)

_success_criteria: A granularity change is GOOD iff: mean_paragraphs UP vs baseline AND mean_distinctness >= baseline AND mean_confidence >= baseline-0.05 AND total_violations == 0 AND mean_unique_openers >= baseline. (More paragraphs WITHOUT new repetition / drift / hallucination.)
